Title: Native integration between Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Functions

Body.Content:
With the native integration between Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Functions, you will be able to simply add a trigger function directly from your Azure Cosmos DB account. The benefit of trigger functions is that it only executes when an event happens that triggers a function call. Using Azure Functions and Azure Cosmos DB, you will be able to create and deploy event-driven, planet-scale, serverless apps with extremely low-latency access against very rich data for an enormous number of customers across the globe.
